nodes.label: Whack-a-Mole project brief v2.1
nodes.description: 2026 S2 ENGG3000 SPINE engineering project, version 2.1 released 17 August 2026.

nodes.label: Full-body Whack-a-Mole game
nodes.description: Body motion controls cursor; randomly appearing moles award a point if reached before disappearance; increasing difficulty levels.

nodes.label: Ultrasound-only person tracking
nodes.description: Track the player using only ultrasound; integrate sensor data into calibrated spatial positions; accuracy and responsiveness must suffice for gameplay.

nodes.label: Playing area geometry
nodes.description: Open playing area 1.5 m wide by 1.4 m deep beyond a dead zone. All system components must remain within 50 cm of wall, outside playing area.

nodes.label: 60 cm dead-zone warning
nodes.description: Dead zone extends 60 cm from screen wall; entry triggers audible alarm and effective visual warning.
nodes.rationale: Prevent players running into the screen.

nodes.label: Standalone wireless sensor boxes
nodes.description: Each sensor box no larger than 100 x 100 x 150 mm; communicates wirelessly with PC. Performance checklist says sensors less than those dimensions.

nodes.label: Four-AA NiMH battery power
nodes.description: Each box uses only four AA NiMH batteries, runs one hour; performance benchmark asks evidence of life greater than one hour. USB-A recharge desirable, not essential.

nodes.label: Installable Windows game package
nodes.description: Game software must be downloadable and installable on Windows laptop.

nodes.label: ESP32 processor boards
nodes.description: Two supplied boards at $8 each.

nodes.label: RCWL-1601 ultrasound sensors
nodes.description: Four supplied sensors at $2.70 each.

nodes.label: Project component budget
nodes.description: $100 including supplied components; two antennas $0, two four-AA battery packs $7 each; extra batteries $6.50 each and holders $3 each.

nodes.label: Approved component suppliers
nodes.description: Bunnings, RS Online, Core Electronics, Jaycar. One opportunity for requested component ordering; consider stock and lead times.

nodes.label: Non-destructive supplied components
nodes.description: Neat enclosures, sound electronics, supplied components returned in good working order; no solder, adhesives, paint or similar applied to supplied components.

nodes.label: Sprint 1 MVP
nodes.description: Week 5 integrated proof-of-concept V1 demonstrates baseline loop; 25% assessment: 5% group demo, 5% individual peer assessment, 15% traceability and ideation log.

nodes.label: Sprint 2 Critical Design Review
nodes.description: Week 9 ruggedized and optimized V2; compare empirical metrics against V1. 35% assessment: 10% group demo, 10% peer, 15% engineering rigour and change log.

nodes.label: Sprint 3 Final Product
nodes.description: Week 13 enclosed integrated V3 validated under real-world stress; 40% assessment: 15% group stress test, 15% peer, 10% public exhibition oral pitch.

nodes.label: Engineering Rigour and Change Log
nodes.description: Mathematical modelling, simulation calibration, physical testing, formal change register tracking V1 failures resolved in V2, and personal knowledge-gap evaluation.

nodes.label: Animated Square Demo
nodes.description: 690-frame animation; sampled frames show a cyan square at different positions on a black rectangular field.

nodes.label: Two-node body tracker
nodes.description: Current scope: one person, two ESP32s, two positional servos, two trigger/echo ultrasound sensors, wireless PC localization and a cyan dot.

nodes.label: Black-screen cyan dot visualizer
nodes.description: Python 3.10+ with Tk, no third-party runtime libraries; supports simulation, calibration, diagnostics and fullscreen.

nodes.label: PC measurement coordinator
nodes.description: PC coordinates wireless measurements and performs localization; ESP32 firmware handles local sensing.

nodes.label: Twenty-position acquisition sweep
nodes.description: Visits 20 candidate positions including near corners, far region and dead-zone row; long servo movement may require a repeat at the same aim.
nodes.rationale: A wider sweep increases spatial coverage at the cost of potentially many seconds of acquisition or reacquisition.

nodes.label: Empty-area calibration
nodes.description: Three-second lead-in, three range pairs per position; median of successful echoes per bearing, no background echo when fewer than two succeed. Invalid servo responses or lost packets fail calibration.

nodes.label: Wall-relative tracking geometry
nodes.description: Metres: x=0..1.5, y=0.60..2.00; default sensors at (0,0.20) and (1.50,0.20); positive y points away from wall and 90 degrees faces forward.

nodes.label: Forward two-circle localization
nodes.description: Two calibrated ranges give a forward intersection; reject impossible intersections. Both returns must correspond to a common reflector, an assumption human bodies can violate.
nodes.rationale: The positive root selects the space in front of the sensor baseline and leaves the region behind it unobservable.

nodes.label: Beam and speed consistency filters
nodes.description: Geometry, bearing consistency, speed and range checks reject implausible fixes but do not prove target identity.

nodes.label: Range-pair freshness gate
nodes.description: Default max_pair_skew_s=0.25 seconds between response receipt times; older pairs are rejected and repeated at the same aim.
nodes.rationale: Prevents large temporal mismatch between left and right ranges; receipt-time gating is not synchronized acoustic timing or a position-error guarantee.

nodes.label: Time-based display smoothing
nodes.description: Accepted estimates pass through a time-based display filter; the raw estimate controls the warning to avoid smoothing delay.

nodes.label: Dead-zone diagnostic warning
nodes.description: Detected near-wall positions activate visible warning and throttled system bell; warning release needs 3 cm clearance beyond the near boundary. Blind spots remain.

nodes.label: Tracking-loss display behaviour
nodes.description: The dot disappears after an invalid pair or one second without an accepted fix; missing echoes cannot imply a safe position.

nodes.label: Calibrated bearing selection
nodes.description: Every tracking angle snaps to an existing node-profile bearing; unprofiled directions cannot bypass the background filter.

nodes.label: WM1 ASCII wire protocol
nodes.description: HELLO, MEASURE and RANGE messages use node IDs, nonzero uint32 sequences, integer millidegrees, millimetres and OK/TIMEOUT/INVALID statuses.

nodes.label: UDP node discovery
nodes.description: Nodes listen on UDP4211 and announce every two seconds; PC listens on UDP4210. Discovered nodes expire after six seconds; duplicate IDs suspend the node.

nodes.label: Explicit sensor IP configuration
nodes.description: The --nodes option supplies both sensor addresses when broadcast discovery is blocked.

nodes.label: Alternating single-command acquisition
nodes.description: Only one command is outstanding: node 0 then node 1, at least 65 ms after a response before the next request. Timeout is one second followed by a 100 ms guard.
nodes.rationale: Global PC sequencing and quiet intervals reduce acoustic cross-talk between independently running sensor nodes.

nodes.label: Duplicate ping suppression
nodes.description: Identical pending retries are ignored; last 16 results replay without a new ping; older sequences use wrap-aware ordering; conflicting same-sequence angles are ignored.

nodes.label: Thirty-second controller ownership
nodes.description: After 30 seconds without an accepted new command, another controller can take ownership and ordering state clears.

nodes.label: Open-loop servo calibration
nodes.description: Both nodes use world bearings; firmware applies reversal then centre trim, pulse endpoint mapping and travel bounds. Unreachable moves return INVALID.
nodes.rationale: Reported angle is a calibrated command estimate; there is no angle encoder and default pulse endpoints do not establish actual 180-degree travel.

nodes.label: ESP32 GPIO18/19/23 wiring
nodes.description: GPIO18 controls servo, GPIO23 triggers ultrasound, GPIO19 receives echo. GPIO23 avoids the GPIO5 boot strap restriction.

nodes.label: Separate regulated servo power
nodes.description: Servo requires its rated supply and stall-current capacity, with common signal ground. Do not power servo from ESP32 GPIO or 3V3.
nodes.rationale: Separate servo supply avoids regulator overload and Wi-Fi brownouts; exact board input arrangement needs verification.

nodes.label: DOIT ESP32 DevKit V1
nodes.description: Provisional classic ESP32 target; C3/S3 variants require different configuration.

nodes.label: Two ESP32 sensor boards
nodes.description: One processor board per wireless sensor/servo box; actual board models remain to be confirmed.

nodes.label: RCWL-1601 GPIO ultrasonic sensor
nodes.description: User uses two of four supplied RCWL-1601 sensors; verify GPIO variant and actual logic levels. Vendor typical detection angle is ±15 degrees, max ±20, typical cycle 50 ms.

nodes.label: HC-SR04-compatible trigger/echo sensor
nodes.description: Firmware expects GPIO trigger/echo; generic HC-SR04 uses 5 V supply and requires suitable echo level conversion for ESP32.

nodes.label: Positional pan servo
nodes.description: Each sensor rides one positional pan servo. Continuous-rotation models need a different control arrangement.

nodes.label: PlatformIO Espressif32 7.0.1
nodes.description: Pinned build platform supplies Arduino-ESP32 2.0.17, with node_left and node_right targets.

nodes.label: Arduino-ESP32 2.0.17 LEDC API
nodes.description: Firmware uses channel-based LEDC API. Arduino 3 removes ledcSetup and ledcAttachPin, requiring adaptation before core migration.

nodes.label: In-process ideal reflector simulator
nodes.description: --simulate drives an ideal virtual reflector by mouse and models servo delay, alternating pings and beam visibility; bypasses physical hardware.

nodes.label: Two-node UDP sensor emulator
nodes.description: simulate_nodes.py provides two real UDP endpoints on 127.0.0.2/.3:4211, announces to localhost:4210, and models a single ideal reflector.

nodes.label: Loopback UDP integration tests
nodes.description: Tests start the emulator subprocess with temporary calibration and verify discovery, recovery, empty echoes, missing nodes and disconnection expiry.

nodes.label: Native firmware parser and mapping tests
nodes.description: Host C++ tests cover malformed network inputs, wraparound, servo reversal/trim and travel-limit rejection; no actual hardware motion or reflections.
nodes.norm_label: native firmware parser and mapping tests

nodes.label: Left and right ESP32 firmware builds
nodes.description: Both ESP32 targets compiled and native tests passed; no physical board was flashed and actual wiring/servo model remain open.
nodes.norm_label: left and right esp32 firmware builds

nodes.label: Single-node bench probe
nodes.description: tools.probe_node centres or aims one sensor and prints ranges. Only one controller or probe should run at a time.

nodes.label: Tracking CSV recording
nodes.description: --record tracking.csv enables recording; headless calibration is available with both sensors online and nobody in view.

nodes.label: Physical tracking acceptance procedure
nodes.description: Bench checks, geometry/background calibration, coverage, accuracy, latency, recovery, dead-zone classification, battery and dot display validation remain physical evidence requirements.

nodes.label: Interior and boundary accuracy trials
nodes.description: 25 interior points plus exact corners and boundary points; proposed gates are 95% valid updates and <=0.15 m 95th-percentile error after acquisition, not achieved results.

nodes.label: Motion and acquisition timing trials
nodes.description: Proposed locked dot latency gate below 250 ms; measure initial and repeated acquisition separately; a full 20-position sweep may take many seconds.

nodes.label: Four-AA NiMH battery runtime
nodes.description: Each box uses four NiMH AA cells; prove more than one hour of actual tracking operation with current and voltage logs.

nodes.label: Standalone sensor enclosure
nodes.description: Each box fits within 100x100x150 mm with clearance; all hardware and swept volume remain within 0.50 m of wall.

nodes.label: Non-destructive component mounting
nodes.description: Supplied parts must remain working without applied solder, adhesive or paint; use removable headers/clamps.

nodes.label: Hundred-dollar component budget
nodes.description: All supplied parts and added servos/power electronics count toward the $100 project budget.

nodes.label: ES3 Whack-a-Mole v2.1 project brief
nodes.description: Pages 4-6 supply hardware, tracking-area and full-product requirements. Current implementation scope is narrower.

nodes.label: Deferred full-game delivery
nodes.description: Gameplay, scoring, levels and downloadable Windows installer are deferred; diagnostic warning output does not establish final product alarm compliance.

nodes.label: Vendored UART tracking study reference
nodes.description: example-code/tracker.py separates acquisition, filtering and rendering on a different board/UART system; its black-background display is the visual reference. Vendored files unchanged.

nodes.label: Engineering change log
nodes.description: Records subsystem choice, firmware validation and review fixes; body response, accuracy, mechanics and runtime remain unmeasured.

nodes.label: Foreground background-distance rejection
nodes.description: Accept an echo only at a profiled direction and at least 0.15 m nearer than background, or where the profile recorded no return.

nodes.label: Bounded trigger/echo acquisition
nodes.description: 10 microsecond trigger, 25 ms echo timeout, 20-4000 mm firmware distances, at least 65 ms local spacing and configured loaded-servo settling.

nodes.label: Local hardware and geometry configuration
nodes.description: Ignored config.local.h stores Wi-Fi/servo settings; config.local.json stores measured positions, range corrections and tracking limits.

nodes.label: Persistent calibration.local.json profile
nodes.description: Profiles persist empty-room calibration; changed geometry invalidates the profile and moved sensors/furniture require recalibration.

nodes.label: Shared 2.4 GHz local Wi-Fi
nodes.description: PC and both nodes share a local network, with client isolation disabled and local inbound UDP4210 allowed.

nodes.label: Echo voltage divider
nodes.description: For nominal 5 V echo: 2.2 kohm sensor-to-GPIO and 3.3 kohm GPIO-to-ground gives approximately 3.0 V; verify actual voltage.

nodes.label: Unverified physical tracking performance
nodes.description: Compilation and simulations do not establish human reflection behaviour, servo response, spatial accuracy or battery runtime.
